blocks.text: How do Filipinos say “I love you”? Often, not with words, but through the choices they make every day—parents work abroad to give their children a better future, young professionals build their careers to fulfill their dreams. These everyday acts of love are at the heart of Love In Life, InLife’s campaign celebrating its 115th year of serving Filipinos. In 2025, the country’s largest Filipino life insurer reinforced its brand transformation to InLife from its old name Insular Life. InLife is more than a shortened name, it reflects the company’s unwavering commitment to be “in” the lives of Filipinos. InLife remained […]...
